task_description: Write a method in Dafny to move all the numbers to the end of the given string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method MoveNumbersToEnd(s: string) returns (result: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The output string has the same length as the input string
- All numeric characters in the input string are positioned at the end of the output string
- The non-numeric characters appear in the same relative order as in the input string
- The total count of numeric characters in the input and output strings is the same
